.magiclink__wrapper {
  text-align: center;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.magiclink__wrapper.special-offers {
  background-color: transparent;
}
.magiclink__wrapper p, .magiclink__wrapper h1 {
  padding: 0;
}
.magiclink__wrapper h1.font--headline {
  font-size: 24px;
}
.magiclink__wrapper a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .magiclink__container {
  padding: 48px;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .magiclink__container.magiclink__bad-password, .magiclink__wrapper .magiclink__container.magiclink__finish-setting-your-acct {
  padding-top: 24px;
}
@media screen and (max-width: 655px) {
  .magiclink__wrapper .magiclink__container {
    padding-left: 24px;
    padding-right: 24px;
  }
}
.magiclink__wrapper .magiclink__container.magiclink__logmein {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 300px;
  padding: 0;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .inner-content {
  background-color: #ffffff;
  padding: 16px 24px;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .icon-inbox {
  height: 60px;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .icon-inbox > div {
  background-color: #fff;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .resending {
  color: #00b16a;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .resending.error {
  color: #d9202c;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .header {
  background-color: #e1e1e1;
  height: 48px;
  color: #888;
  font-size: 14px;
  border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
  font-weight: 400;
  border: 1px solid rgb(241, 241, 241);
  display: flex;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .header .header-content {
  display: flex;
  margin-left: 16px;
  width: 100%;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .header .header-content a {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #888888;
  text-decoration: none;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .header .header-content a:hover {
  text-decoration: underline;
}
.magiclink__wrapper .header .header-content a span {
  margin-left: 2px;
